d:
French football superstar Kylian Mbappe gets cancelled by China after he accidentally calls former Chinese Supreme Leader mao Zedong a dictator. Mbappe loses several brand deals in China, and Beijing refuses to broadcast LaLiga football matches when Mbappe plays for Real Madrid. Firstpost looks at the backlash to Mbappe's comments in China. Hem Kaur Saroya explains the controversies surrounding Mao Zedong. HKS also looks at Mbappe's apology, and its impact.
